Google TV offers no choice of home screen. Two ways:
1. Redirect the Home button: turn on “Glas Launcher” in the accessibility settings. If a “Restricted setting” message appears, first choose Apps → Glas Launcher → ⋮ “Allow restricted settings”.
2. Turn off the Google interface (most reliable): set “Google TV interface” above to Off, or on a computer:
adb shell pm disable-user --user 0 com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx
